title: Binary Tree Cameras
inputFormat: Implement minCameraCover(root). The runner converts the level-order input array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: The minimum number of cameras needed to cover every node. A camera covers its own node, its parent, and its immediate children.
